extensionDescription.message: Read web text aloud with local English and Arabic voices.

localPrivacy.message: Page text stays on this device.

restrictedPageError.message: This page does not allow Open Speechy to read its content.

optionsLede.message: Choose a voice for each language. Page text stays in this browser; system voices and installed models do the talking.

autoVoiceHelp.message: Auto mode picks a local Premium or Enhanced system voice first.

macVoiceHelp.message: For a higher-quality system voice, open System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices. Download a Premium English voice or an Enhanced Arabic voice, then restart Chrome. Siri voices are not exposed to Chrome.

auditionHelp.message: Play a short sample of any voice. On-device voices download the first time you play them.

noVoices.message: No voices were reported by Chrome.

serverUseHelp.message: Disable this to use only browser and system voices.

pairCodeHelp.message: Open the local pairing page, then enter its one-time code.

serverFootnote.message: The server listens only on 127.0.0.1 and answers this extension. Models download from pinned revisions on first use.

readingHelp.message: Set how the reader handles page text, motion, and local models.

selectionChipHelp.message: Show a read button next to selections over 20 characters.

readCodeBlocksHelp.message: Include preformatted code in article extraction.

arabicDiacritizationHelp.message: Experimental local model; disabled until benchmarked.

pdfHelp.message: Open PDF links in the local reader when supported.

highlightEnabledHelp.message: Keep timing colors visible while the page is read.

modelsHelp.message: Remove a model to free space. It downloads again the next time a voice needs it.

kokoroVoiceEmbeddings.message: Voice embeddings download when a voice is first used.
